messages:
Tanya Patel: Heads-up — Oracle APAC marketplace reviewer asked for SOC2 Type II + a recent 3P pen-test attestation before listing. They also want a named evidence owner and a 2-week redaction upload window. Who can own the artifacts?
Ben (Platform): We can own the SOC2 upload and presigned links. Do they want the full report or just an AICPA bridge letter + executive summary?
Maria - Security: They expect the full SOC2 Type II report + a bridge letter if the period doesn't fully cover. For pen test they require an external vendor report within 12 months + remediation attestation. Important: do NOT upload raw vuln scan outputs. Provide a redacted executive summary + a signed attestation PDF. I can run redaction. Example redaction command I use: ```./scripts/redact_scans.sh --input scans/ocp-apac --output redacted/ocp-apac --mask ips,urls,emails```
Sahil - Partnerships: Marketplace also needs a vendor contact for the pen-test and an NDA signed that covers evidence handling. I'll draft a short addendum. Also note Oracle asks that the evidence owner be an employee contact with an email on our domain.
marketplace-bot: Ticket created: #MP-EVID-7213 — evidence request assigned to partnerships (link: https://issues.redwood.ai/MP-EVID-7213)
Tanya Patel: Proposed timeline: pen-test kickoff wk of Apr 18, vendor report by Apr 30, remediation attestation by May 7, upload window May 8–21, listing review by May 28. Is that feasible?
Ben (Platform): Feasible from infra side. I'll provision presigned upload buckets with SSE-KMS and strict ACLs. I will own the upload step and generate per-file presigned URLs. :+1:
Maria - Security: I'll prepare the redacted exec summary and attestation template. Plan: generate redaction artifacts by May 3, send to Ben for upload. Also will verify no PII or internal hostnames leaked.
Sahil - Partnerships: I'll get NDA + vendor details. @Maria can you confirm what the attestation wording should look like? I can mirror Oracle's marketplace wording.
Maria - Security: Attestation should state: "All identified high/critical findings have been remediated or accepted by engineering with compensating controls; raw scan logs were reviewed and not uploaded. Redacted summary and remediation evidence provided." I will attach a signed PDF.
Tanya Patel: Great — owners: Ben = SOC2 & upload, Maria = redaction + attestation, Sahil = vendor NDA & vendor contact. I'll update the partner listing checklist and ping the reviewer with the timeline. Please drop any blockers here asap.
Ben (Platform): Blocker: need KMS key ARN for the evidence bucket (security to provide). Maria, can you DM the sample redaction output so I can test the upload flow?
Maria - Security: Will DM and upload sample to s3://redwood-partner-evidence/ocp/apac/1955554321/sample-redacted-exec-summary.pdf
Sahil - Partnerships: I'll attach the draft NDA to the ticket by EOD.
marketplace-bot: Reminder set: evidence upload window opens in 2 weeks (automated reminder in #partnerships).
